seo.title: Communities and neighborhoods
seo.description: The rural communities and city neighborhoods of Saint Anthony of Padua Parish in Dois Vizinhos: patron saints, stories and the families who welcomed them.

hero.title: {{count}} communities, one family.
hero.lead: Each community has its patron saint, its chapel and its story. Discover when the faith arrived in each place and who welcomed it.

empty: No community found. Try another name.

sao-jose-do-canoas.charism: A humble carpenter and foster father of Jesus, Saint Joseph is a model of a just, hard-working man. That is why so many families place themselves under his protection.

santa-terezinha.patron: Saint Thérèse of the Child Jesus
santa-terezinha.charism: Patroness of the missions, Saint Thérèse protects all who proclaim the Gospel around the world. May she encourage missionaries never to give up.

sao-judas-tadeu-jacutinga.charism: One of the most popular saints, known as the patron of impossible causes. In his letter he urged Christians to keep their faith pure.

linha-benetti.charism: A convert to Christianity, Saint Catherine was martyred for refusing to deny her faith. She is invoked by those who work with wheels, such as drivers and millers.

linha-ibiaca.charism: Devotion to the Mother of Consolation began in Turin, before an ancient image of the Virgin. Since then people have turned to her above all in illness and suffering.

sao-luiz.charism: Born in 1568 to a wealthy Italian family, he chose charity from childhood. He died at 23 caring for plague victims and is the patron of youth.

volta-grande.charism: A just and hard-working man, Saint Joseph accepted to be the father of Jesus and the husband of Mary, Mother of the Savior. He is the model for sanctifying daily work.

flor-da-serra.charism: Bishop and martyr of Poland, Saint Stanislaus gave his life defending the Gospel and the dignity of his people.

sao-cristovao.charism: Protector of drivers and farmers. Many devotees come to ask his blessing for journeys, work in the fields and school transport.

santa-cruz.charism: Known as the kind saint, he shared his inheritance with the poor and cared for plague victims. He is also invoked as protector of animals.

sao-bras.charism: Chosen by the devotion of the pioneer families, Saint Blaise is the protector of the throat and watches over the community's homes.

sao-francisco-do-bandeira.charism: Patron of ecology, Francis took the Gospel literally: he lived poverty, loved the poor and cared for all creation.

sao-miguel-do-canoas.charism: Prince of the angels and defender against evil, Saint Michael protects families and is remembered as the saint of perseverance.

santa-luzia-do-bandeira.charism: A young martyr of great faith, she consecrated her life to Christ. She is the protector of the eyes and of sight.

piracema.charism: The faithful welcomed their patroness as a blessing for everyone. Since her arrival, many have witnessed graces received through her intercession.

sao-pedro-do-bandeira.charism: A fisherman who became a fisher of men, he was the first Pope of the Church. He protects fishermen and widows; his feast is on June 29.

vila-canarinho.charism: Mother of all humanity and servant of the Lord, Mary remains attentive to the needs of her children, just as she was to Jesus.

sao-francisco-de-assis.charism: Francis knew Saint Anthony and guided him in Franciscan life. He lived simply, loved creation and had a special tenderness for the poor.

margarida-galvan.charism: At Fátima, Our Lady asked the shepherd children not to be afraid and to pray the rosary every day for peace in the world.

bairro-da-luz.charism: The neighborhood's name comes from the residents' devotion to Our Lady of Light, whose light reaches every member of the parish.

jardim-da-colina.charism: Foster father of Jesus, Saint Joseph is a model head of the family, respectful husband and worker. He is also patron of a holy death.

vitoria.charism: Also called Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal. The neighborhood's families credit her with the grace of owning their own homes.
